summary: GLOCAL is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in global markets and local creativities, led by the University of Glasgow with Barcelona, Erasmus University Rotterdam, Uppsala, Göttingen, Kyoto and Los Andes in Bogotá. About 60 regular scholarships plus up to 20 for targeted regions pay full tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month. The scholarship deadline is 14 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time.
meta_title: GLOCAL 2027: Erasmus Mundus Global Markets scholarship
meta_description: GLOCAL pays tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month for a global markets master's from Glasgow to Barcelona, Uppsala, Kyoto or Bogotá. Apply by 14 January 2027.
covers: Full tuition fees, including the deposit. Self-funded international students pay £21,010 (€24,250) a year.
Either €1,400 a month for two years, or three €1,000 advances for travel and settling in plus €1,275 a month.
eligibility: Applicants from any region, with no more than six scholarships per nationality across four editions.
A strict upper second (2:1) or international equivalent in a subject such as anthropology, business, economics, global studies, history, international relations, political science or sociology.
The Göttingen tracks also need at least 60 ECTS in economics, business, modern or economic and social history, sociology or politics.
A conditional or unconditional University of Glasgow offer, English at Glasgow's required level, and no previous Erasmus Mundus scholarship.
how_to_apply: Choose one of the study tracks, which combine Glasgow with two of Barcelona, Uppsala, Rotterdam, Göttingen, Kyoto and Los Andes. Track H is not recruiting for 2027.

Apply through the University of Glasgow's portal with the scholarship form, a CV, a personal statement of up to 1,200 words, two references dated within 24 months, transcripts and degree certificates with translations, proof of English and a passport scan.
Submit by 14 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time. Scholarship results are announced in April 2027.
watch_out: Proof of English must be in by the scholarship deadline, not later.
Glasgow treats only degrees from the UK's majority English-speaking countries as proof of English, and Ghana and Nigeria are not on that list, so plan for a test.
Applications by email are not accepted.
costs: Tuition (£21,010 a year for international students)
€1,400 a month, or €1,275 a month plus €3,000 in advances
documents: Transcripts and degree certificates, with English translations

faq.q: When is the GLOCAL scholarship deadline?
faq.a: 14 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time. Results come out in April 2027.

faq.q: How many GLOCAL scholarships are there?
faq.a: About 60 regular scholarships across the editions, plus up to 20 more for students from targeted regions, with at most six per nationality.
A strict 2:1 or equivalent in subjects such as business, economics, history, international relations, political science, sociology, anthropology or global studies.
